FLAGELLANT-SHOULD_PLAY_CARD_ANIM_AND_SOU: Should Play Card Anim And Sound
Should Play Card Anim And Sound
Some of the Flagellant's cards have special selection and play animations and corresponding sounds.
FLAGELLANT-SHOULD_MUTE_SEPARATELY.title: Should Only Mute Unique Card Volume
Only affect the Flagellant's card select and play sfx.
FLAGELLANT-FLAGELLANT_AUDIO_SOUND_VOLUME: The Flagellant's unique volume control of card select and play/pressure changes/entering toxic states.

With the game volume at 100, 0dB is already quite high! Playing the same cards with sound effects rapidly may cause the volume to suddenly increase due to overlapping sound effects! (Please be mindful of the volume level and protect your ears!)
FLAGELLANT-SHOULD_SHOW_CARD_ANIM_IN_MULT: Should Show Card Anim In Multiplayer Mode
Should Show Teammate Flagellant's Select Card Anim
Checking this option will allow you see teammate Flagellant's card select animation in multiplayer mode.
FLAGELLANT-SHOULD_USE_DEATH_DOOR_IDLE.ho: It is considered that Flagellant enters Death Door if the Flagellant's current Hp is equal to Doom or less.
After checking, if Flagellant is in Death Door, the Idle anim will be switched to the Death Door Idle anim.
